title: Identity-Aware BiLSTM Toxicity Classifier
summary: The solution tokenizes lowercased comments with a regex, builds a fit-split frequency vocabulary, maps unknown words to a dedicated ID, truncates to 220 tokens, and caches encoded train/validation arrays. A two-layer bidirectional LSTM processes spatially dropped 300-dimensional word embeddings. Masked temporal max and mean pooling are concatenated, passed through two residual ReLU linear layers, and produce toxicity plus identity logits. Training uses length-bucketed shuffled batches, mixed precision, Adam, gradient clipping, and epoch-wise learning-rate decay. The main BCE loss uses fractional toxicity targets and identity-aware weights that upweight identity rows, background positives, and subgroup negatives; masked BCE auxiliary losses supervise available identity labels. A whole-model fine-tuning stage retains BCE and adds a logistic pairwise ranking loss over overall and subgroup, BPSN, and BNSP pools, with smooth worst-pool aggregation. Two independently seeded models are trained; sigmoid toxicity predictions are averaged for validation inference.
